NPCs can provide services, have shops, or just present fun interactions, making puns or discussing work. ------- These NPCs will either sell you something, or provide a service. ### The Blacksmith [![Blacksmith.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/b/be/Blacksmith.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/The_Blacksmith "The Blacksmith") [The Blacksmith](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/The_Blacksmith "The Blacksmith") is an important npc that helps players alter the stats or tier of their equipment. He can be found nearby [Explorer](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Explorer "Explorer") in [Town](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/index.php?title=Town&action=edit&redlink=1 "Town (page does not exist)") and [Tavern](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Tavern "Tavern") . ### Explorer [![RelicHunter.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/7/78/RelicHunter.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Explorer "Explorer") [Explorer](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Explorer "Explorer") (formerly The Relic Hunter) is a vendor that sells [survival](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Survival "Survival") drops such as chests or shards to players in cost of godly orbs. He can be found nearby [The Blacksmith](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/The_Blacksmith "The Blacksmith") in [Town](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/index.php?title=Town&action=edit&redlink=1 "Town (page does not exist)") and [Tavern](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Tavern "Tavern") . ### Gran Ma'ster's Shop [![GranMaster.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/2/2a/GranMaster.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:GranMaster.png) Gran Ma'ster is a vendor in the tavern that sells [Shards](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shards "Shards") that are available to all [Heroes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes") for [Gems](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gems "Gems") . She sold Skill Spheres prior to the Trials update, where Skill Spheres were removed. She can be found standing next to the War Recruiter behind the Training Dummies in Tavern, or on the right side of the Pirate Ship in Town. ### Mananode [![Mananode.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/4/4c/Mananode.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Mananode.png) The Mananode is a guardian of the [Ancient Ruins](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Maps#Ancient_Ruins "Maps") , you will first encounter him in the [Adventure](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Adventures "Adventures") for The Kobold Bling King. Mananode's main feature in Town is to help you [Ancient Power](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Ancient_Power "Ancient Power") . Mananode also gives you your green mana to build defenses at the start of Build Phase. Mananode can be found only in the Town, he's between the Pirate ship and the Mysterious Portal. ### Petrinarian and Stable Boy's Pets Shop [![PetrinarianPicture.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/9/96/PetrinarianPicture.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:PetrinarianPicture.png) Interacting with the Petrinarian will open the Petrinarian window, allowing you to view, equip, feed, power up, and evolve your [Pets](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Pets "Pets") . You can find her to the right of spawn in Tavern or to the left of the First Mate in Town. | | | --- | | | | [![StableBoy.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/0/05/StableBoy.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:StableBoy.png)

The Stable Boy will open the Hatchery window when interacted with, which can be used to hatch any Pet Eggs you may have.
Both windows can always be accessed, whomever of the two you may decide to interact with.
You can find him to the right of spawn in Tavern or to the left of the First Mate in Town. | ### Professor Proteus [![ProfessorProteus.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/2/2f/ProfessorProteus.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Tinkering "Tinkering") Professor Sebastian Proteus, also known as "The Tinkerer" is the genius who adapted gear to have [Mods](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mods "Mods") on them. He's also the creator of Protobot and the Sky City Bank. Professor Proteus allows you to transfer mods from one item (e.g relic to relic, helmet to helmet,). This process costs [Defender Medals](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defender_Medals "Defender Medals") or [Gems](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gems "Gems") as well as the respective upgrade material (e.g Plain Leather, Plain Iron Hammer). For a comprehensive list of materials, see [Crafting Materials](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Crafting_Materials "Crafting Materials") . Professor Proteus can be found left of the Blacksmith in Tavern, or when going right in Town. [Click here to learn more about tinkering.](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Tinkering "Tinkering") ### Protobot [![Protobot.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/c/c7/Protobot.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Protobot.png) Protobot operates the Sky City Bank, which is a place to store items you don't want to keep in your inventory. Each player may unlock up to 12 Vaults and a Material Vault with [Gems](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gems "Gems") . You can find Protobot and the Sky City Bank next to the Training Dummies in Tavern or behind the Emporium and to the right of the Relic Hunter in Town. ### Knight Commander [![KnightCommander.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/8/8e/KnightCommander.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:KnightCommander.png) The Knight Commander will inform you of newly unlocked Campaign maps and any Campaign-related quests you may have, although he does not do anything after you've beaten the [Campaign](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Campaign "Campaign") and the [Questlines](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Questline "Questline") . ### The Tavernkeeper [![Tavernkeep.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/8/81/Tavernkeep.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Tavernkeep.png) The Tavernkeeper may be interacted with to report any bugs you find. The Tavernkeep can be found behind the bar of the Tavern and Outside Tavern in Town. ### Scavenger [![ScavengerPic.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/b/ba/ScavengerPic.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:ScavengerPic.png) When your inventory has completely filled up, the Scavenger will collect any further items dropped on a map. He also picks up items dropped from enemies killed by falling off the map. These items will remain in the Scavenger's inventory for a limited amount of time (3 hours) (or 30 minutes on rare occasion) until he gets rid of them. You can find the Scavenger to your right when spawning in the Tavern, or right of the Dragon Statue in the middle of Town. ### Shady Merchant [![Shady Merchant.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/2/2a/Shady_Merchant.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Shady_Merchant.png) Talking to the Shady Merchant will bring up the [Missions](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Missions "Missions") Menu (accessed also by pressing ["J" on Keyboard](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Controls "Controls") or [LB + DPadUp on Controller)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Controls "Controls") . He can be found behind the Tavernkeep's Bar in both Town and Tavern. ### Black Market Dealer [![BlackMarketDealer.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/f/f2/BlackMarketDealer.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Black_Market "Black Market") The Black Market Dealer sells you [Goblin Item Insurance](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Goblin_Item_Insurance "Goblin Item Insurance") scrolls for [Gems](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gems "Gems") , [Defender Medals](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defender_Medals "Defender Medals") , or [Gold](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gold "Gold") . He also sells you golden [Flairs](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Flairs#Black_Market_Exclusives "Flairs") ranging anywhere from 250 million to 1 billion [Gold](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gold "Gold") , which is replaced every once in a while. [Click here to view the black market.](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Black_Market "Black Market") ### Colonel [![Colonel.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/0/02/Colonel.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Colonel) The Colonel sells you rare Pet Eggs and Pet Affection Boosters for [Defender Medals](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defender_Medals "Defender Medals") . The Colonel can be found behind Professor Proteus in Tavern, or in the Pirate Ship in Town. [Click here to learn more about the Colonel's Shop.](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Colonel "Colonel") ### War Recruiter [![War Recruiter.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/1/11/War_Recruiter.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:War_Recruiter.png) The War Recruiter is a vendor in the tavern that sells [Shard Packs](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shards#Shards_Packs "Shards") for [Shard Dust](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shards#Shard_Dust "Shards") . Giving War Recruiter 10 [Shard Dust](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shards#Shard_Dust "Shards") will grant you 1 [Shard](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shards "Shards") in return for the respective tier. He can be found standing next to Gran Ma'ster. ### Wayfarer [![Wayfarer.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/c/c4/Wayfarer.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Wayfarer "Wayfarer") [![Christmas Wayfarer.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/7/71/Christmas_Wayfarer.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Wayfarer "Wayfarer") By completing specific [Incursion](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Incursion "Incursion") [maps](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Maps "Maps") , you can purchase unique [weapons](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Weapons "Weapons") for 500 [Defender Medals](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defender_Medals "Defender Medals") . The stats of the weapon are based upon your strongest hero. The item will tell you which [Incursion](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Incursions "Incursions") you need to complete to unlock it. The [Wayfarer](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Wayfarer "Wayfarer") can be found only in [Town](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/index.php?title=Town&action=edit&redlink=1 "Town (page does not exist)") , between the Pirate Ship and the Mysterious Portal. [Click here to see what weapons the Wayfarer might sell you.](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Wayfarer "Wayfarer") ### The Enchantress [![TheEnchantress.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/d/d6/TheEnchantress.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Enchantress) The Enchantress provides a Disenchanting service, allowing you to convert [materials](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Crafting_Materials "Crafting Materials") into lower quality [materials](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Crafting_Materials "Crafting Materials") . You can find her in the tavern sitting at a table near the Pirate Cove, or next to the Blacksmith in Town. [Click here to learn more about her conversion rates.](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Enchantress "Enchantress") ### Ol Peepers [![Ol Peepers.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/d/d3/Ol_Peepers.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Ol_Peepers.png) Ol Peepers sells you a [Carnival Crate](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Carnival_Crate "Carnival Crate") every day you log in for 1000 [gold](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gold "Gold") . ### First Mate [![FirstMate.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/3/3b/FirstMate.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Material_Shop) The First Mate sells you [Crafting Materials](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Crafting_Materials "Crafting Materials") for [Gems](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gems "Gems") or [Defender Medals](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defender_Medals "Defender Medals") , also known as the [Material Shop](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Material_Shop "Material Shop") . First mate is located beside the Colonel in the tavern or near the Mailbox in Town. [Click here to learn more about the Material Shop prices.](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Material_Shop "Material Shop") The Emporium ------------ The NPCs in the Emporium let you access all kinds of Cosmetics for both you and your towers. ### Seamstress's Costume Shop [![Seamstress3.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/2/21/Seamstress3.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Costumes "Costumes") You can purchase and equip [Costumes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Costumes "Costumes") here. The Seamstress can be found in the Emporium. ### Francisco's Tower Skins [![Francisco.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/c/cc/Francisco.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Tower_Skins "Tower Skins") You can purchase different [Tower Skins](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Tower_Skins "Tower Skins") here. Francisco can be found in the Emporium. ### Sigvald [![Sigvald.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/5/5e/Sigvald.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Sigvald.png) Sigvald is a direct link to the in-game shop. You can find Sigvald in the Emporium ### Protean & Seaworthy Weapons [![BoughtWeapons.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/e/e6/BoughtWeapons.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:BoughtWeapons.png) Here you can buy weapons with special kill animations for [Gems](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gems "Gems") ### Ol Jeepers [![Ol Jeepers.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/0/02/Ol_Jeepers.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Ol_Jeepers.png) You can view the [Defender Pass](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Defender_Pass "Defender Pass") through Ol Jeepers. He can be found at entrance of the "Emporium" area in both town and tavern. Royalty ------- In the many maps you'll play in Etheria, you'll sometimes find the King and Prince of Dragonfall watching you. ### The King [![King.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/1/1d/King.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:King.png) The King of Dragonfall is a serious and stoic man. Throughout the [Campaign](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Campaign "Campaign") he will speak to you, tell you what your objective is and explain Etheria. ### The Prince [![Prince.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/b/b4/Prince.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Prince.png) The Prince of Dragonfall is a happy and cheerful child. You will first see him cheering you on from the top of [The Gates of Dragonfall](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/The_Gates_of_Dragonfall "The Gates of Dragonfall") , and later from the throne in the [Throne Room](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/The_Throne_Room "The Throne Room") . ### The Queen [![Queen.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/a/ab/Queen.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Queen.png) Not much is known about the Queen. The only evidence of her existence is from a banner in the [Throne Room](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/The_Throne_Room "The Throne Room") . After the raids from [Assault on Throne Room](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Assault_on_Throne_Room "Assault on Throne Room") , the King's banner is torn apart, her's however is left untouched. Others ------ ### The Mailbox [![Mailbox.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/8/88/Mailbox.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Mailbox.png) The Mailbox is used to claim and redeem codes. Things purchased from DLC will automatically appear here. ### Stubborn Old Man [![StubbornOldMan.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/5/5b/StubbornOldMan.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:StubbornOldMan.png) The Stubborn Old Man is the owner of the Objective you need to protect in [Dragonfall Bazaar](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Dragonfall_Bazaar "Dragonfall Bazaar") . In the map he sits on his cart, which is the objective. You can find him near the bar in both the Tavern and Town.
